messages:
anas: opened a small PR to modernize Console observability docs — switch examples from X-Cloud-Trace-Context to W3C traceparent and include a tidy copy-paste widget JSON. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478

docs-bot: Pull request opened by @anas — automated checks: linkcheck FOUND 1 outdated dashboard URL, lint queued.

tess: will take a look. quick notes: use `token_unit_cost` for billing metrics, group by `api_route` + `model`. show per-request header injection for `traceparent` so users can attach traces to single calls. also include a 1-line sampling note.

ryan: added brief TS + Python per-request snippets and a compact widget JSON for copy-paste. TS snippet (shortened to satisfy lint):
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood-ai/sdk'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-chat-7b', messages:[{role:'user',content:'hello'}], headers:{ traceparent: '00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01' } })
```

ryan: widget snippet (copy-paste):
```json
{"widget_type":"cost_breakdown","metrics":["token_unit_cost","latency_ms_p95"],"group_by":["api_route","model"],"time_range":"7d"}
```

tess: nice. add sampling note: "Default hosted tracing sample rate: 1%. Contact infra to increase." Also a troubleshooting tip: "If traces are missing, verify proxies aren’t stripping `traceparent`."

anas: I'll patch the broken dashboard URL and add the sampling/troubleshooting lines, then trigger CI. ETA today — ping me if docs-bot blocks merge. :rocket:
